alintilar: Participants judged that the current stance of monetary policy was restrictive and appeared to be restraining economic activity and inflation.

alintilar: Participants judged that the current stance of monetary policy was restrictive and was putting downward pressure on economic activity and inflation.

alintilar: Participants judged that the current stance of monetary policy was restrictive and that it broadly appeared to be restraining the economy as intended.

A majority of participants judged that one more increase in the target federal funds rate at a future meeting would likely be appropriate, while some judged it likely that no further increases would be warranted.

fomc_2023-06-14.gerekce: Komite faiz oranını sabit tutarak ek bilgileri değerlendirme imkanı bulmuş, ancak enflasyonu yüzde 2 hedefine döndürmek için ilave sıkılaştırma potansiyelini açıkta bırakmıştır. Mevcut duruşun sıkılaştırıcı etkileri vurgulanmaktadır.

fomctut_2023-05-03.gerekce: Komite, enflasyon risklerine karşı yüksek derecede dikkatli kalındığını ve ek sıkılaştırmanın uygun olup olmayacağının gelen verilere bağlı olarak değerlendirileceğini belirtmiştir. Mevcut 25 baz puanlık artış ile politika duruşu belirgin şekilde sıkılaştırılmıştır.
alintilar: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 5 to 5-1/4 percent.

In determining the extent to which additional policy firming may be appropriate to return inflation to 2 percent over time, the Committee will take into account the cumulative tightening of monetary policy, the lags with which monetary policy affects economic activity and inflation, and economic and financial developments.
The Committee remains highly attentive to inflation risks.
